metadata.title: The Whispering Gate
metadata.description: A forgotten knight awakens in a mist-shrouded forest, tasked with finding the lost key to the Sunken Temple. Strange echoes guide them through ancient ruins as shadows whisper secrets that could change their fate forever.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1.name: The Awakening
act_1.description: The knight awakens in a damp cell and begins to decipher the initial mystery.

scene_cell_wake.name: Cold Stone Cell
scene_cell_wake.description: The knight wakes up in a cold, damp stone cell surrounded by fog that seems to move on its own.

scene_mist_corridor.name: Shifting Corridor
scene_mist_corridor.description: The knight pushes through the fog into a corridor that shifts shape as they move.

obj_escape_cell.description: Find a way out of the cell without touching the walls.

act_2.name: The Temple's Heart
act_2.description: The knight enters the inner sanctum, confronts the guardian, and discovers the portal's true purpose.

scene_sanctum_gate.name: The Inner Sanctum
scene_sanctum_gate.description: The knight steps into a grand hall where shadows whisper secrets of an ancient war.

scene_final_portal.name: The Glowing Portal
scene_final_portal.description: The knight stands before a glowing portal, realizing the shadows were testing their resolve.

obj_uncover_truth.description: Speak with the guardian to learn the temple's true purpose.

act_2.ending_narration: The shadows parted as the door opened to reveal a new destiny. The knight understood that the key was never meant to be found by a mortal, but carried within them all along.

npc_ancient_guardian.name: The Silent Sentinel

persona.voice: Deep, resonant, echoing as if from a cavern
motives: To filter worthy souls from the unworthy
To maintain the balance between worlds
persona.speech_style: Monosyllabic, rhythmic, often pausing between words

knows: The true purpose of the gate
can_reveal: The password of the inner sanctum
The meaning of the cryptic carvings

npc_mist_walker.name: Whisper

motives: To guide or confuse depending on the traveler's intent
fears: Facing a mind that remembers everything
persona.speech_style: Hesitant, whispering, shifting between past and present tenses

knows: The secrets of the previous knights
The location of the forgotten key

npc_illusion_mistress.name: Lady of the Mirror

motives: To tempt the player into self-doubt
To see if they trust their own reflection
fears: Being recognized for what she truly is

knows: The illusion of the final door
can_reveal: The cost of the final trial

npc_last_knight.name: Sir Valerius

persona.voice: Crackling, like an old fire dying
motives: To warn the current knight of the burden ahead
To ensure the cycle is broken
persona.speech_style: Formal, storytelling, referring to himself in third person

knows: The true nature of the portal
can_reveal: The name of the true master
The method to unlock the final seal

item_rusted_key.name: Rusted Key
item_rusted_key.description: A small, corroded key found in the player's pocket, seemingly out of place. It hums faintly when near stone walls.

item_phantom_mirror.name: Phantom Mirror
item_phantom_mirror.description: A shard of glass that shows not your reflection, but your potential future, shifting like smoke.

item_tinder_heart.name: Tinder Heart
item_tinder_heart.description: A small, beating ember wrapped in cloth that never goes cold. Used to light dark places.

item_iron_cord.name: Iron Cord
item_iron_cord.description: A length of flexible metal wire that can bind shadows or cut through illusions.

skill_read_fog.name: Read the Fog
skill_read_fog.description: Allows the player to discern the direction and density of the moving fog, revealing hidden paths or traps.

skill_echo_walk.name: Echo Walk
skill_echo_walk.description: Lets the player hear whispers from the environment, granting insights into the history of the current room.

skill_resolve_burst.name: Resolve Burst
skill_resolve_burst.description: Temporarily heightens the player's willpower, allowing them to ignore illusions or withstand mental pressure.
